out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED TOWEL IN BASIN OF HANDWASHING SINK NEAR DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA. OBSERVED SPONGES IN BASIN OF HANDWASHING SINK NEAR COOK-LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC CLEANED SINKS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF UNDERSTAND THAT SINKS SHOULD BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1-DOOR UPR TRUE COOLER, DISPLAY CASE, AND 1- DOOR PEPSI UPR ARE MISSING THERMOMETERS.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC WILL PURCHASE MORE UNIT THERMOMETERS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL UNITS HAVE AN ACCURATE UNIT THERMOMETER.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: VARIOUS manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of DIFFERENT FOOD ITEMS IN THE TWO-DOOR GLASS-FRONT UPR COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE REUSING MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED AND ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE SANITIZER BASIN MISSING IT’S PIPE UNDER THE SINK BASIN. PIC INFORMED THE EHS THAT IS CRACKED AND BROKE OFF A FEW DAYS PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE ENSURE THE PIPING UNDER THE THREE-VAT SINK IS REPAIRED AND PROOF IS SENT TO THE EHS WITHIN 30 DAYS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED TILE GROUTING AND SOME CEILING TILES THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN IN POOR REPAIR.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE FIX TILE GROUTING/FLOOR TILES IN CERTAIN AREAS (NEAR DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA AND COOK-LINE ESPECIALLY) THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN. BROKEN OR LOOSE CEILING TILES THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN SHOULD BE REPAIRED AS WELL.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED MOLD IN THE ICE BOX.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: BURGER AND EGG ITEMS ON MENU. OBSERVED A NEW OR CHANGED MENU AND SOME MENU ITEMS WERE MISSING ASTERISK.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PLEASE ADD THE ASTERISK TO EVERY MENU ITEM DISCUSSED DURING INSPECTION INCLUDING EGG AND BURGER ITEMS AVAILABLE TO BE SERVED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED. PLEASE SEND ME THE MENU BEFORE PRINTING TO ENSURE IT IS CORRECT.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED RODENT DROPPINGS ON SHELVING, ON THE FLOORS NEAR THE WALLS, UNDERNEATH EQUIPMENT, ON UNUSED EQUIPMENT, AND ON SOME COUNTER SPACE.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE GET PEST CONTROL SERVICE AND FOLLOW THEIR ADVICE ON SEALING HOLES AND GAPS THROUGHOUT FACILITY. PLEASE GET SERVICE AT A HIGHER FREQUENCY UNTIL SITUATION IS UNDER CONTROL. CITY DINER (Inspection Date: 12/05/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED FOOD WORKER RINSE HIS HANDS WITH WATER INSTEAD OF WASHING WITH SOAP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. CDI: FOOD WORKER RE-EDUCATED AND WASHED HIS HANDS PROPERLY WITH SOAP IMMEDIATELY AFTER RINSING.

violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PIC REPLACED PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK AT THE THREE VAT SINK TO HAVE A CONTAINER OF WINDEX IN IT. OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN AREA TO HAVE A METAL SCRUB AND FOOD RESIDUE FILLING THE DRAIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: WINDEX AND METAL SCRUB RELOCATED. PIC RE-EDUCATED. HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ONLY TO BE USED FOR HANDWASHING. CEASE USING THEM FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING ON SITE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: PIC BEGAN DATE MARKING FOODS AT TIME OF INSPECTION. ALL FOODS REQUIRING REFRIGERATION AND KEPT ON SITE FOR OVER 24HRS MUST BE DATE MARKED. EXAMPLE: LASAGNA MADE ON THE 24TH MUST BE USED OR DISPOSED OF ON THE 30TH. PREP: 6/24. USE BY: 6/30.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: LOX EGGS AND ONIONS OMELETTE, ALL ITEMS SERVED WITH COOKED SHELLED EGGS, BEEF LIVER AND ONIONS, NEW YORK STEAK AND FRY SHRIMP, NEW YORK STEAK AND BROILED SALMON, NY CUT STRIP STEAK
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. CONSUMER ADVISORY REMINDER MUST BE ADDED TO THE BOTTOM OF EACH PAGE OF THE MENU CONTAINING AN ASTERISK.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED THREE PIECES OF SALMON COMPLETELY THAWED IN A COOLER WHILE STILL INSIDE VACUUM PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: CDI: SALMON DISPOSED OF. ALL FISH IN VACUUM PACKAGING MUST HAVE THEIR PACKAGE CUT OR FISH MUST BE COMPLETELY REMOVED FROM PACKAGING IMMEDIATELY BEFORE THAWING.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. OBSERVED MULTIPLE WET WIPING CLOTHS ON CUTTING BOARDS AND COUNTERS NOT IN SANITIZER SOLUTION.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. OBTAIN BUCKETS FOR SANITIZER SOLUTION AND KEEP WET WIPING CLOTHS INSIDE OF IT WHILE NOT IN DIRECT USE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting boards throughout the facility are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS WILL PROVIDE DOCUMENT VIA EMAIL.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed utensils stored in water at 106F
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC EMPTIED WATER.
